title: Aurora Music Player
tagline: A modern offline Android music player focused on beautiful UI, performance, and user experience.
description: Aurora Music Player delivers a premium offline listening experience with smooth animations, Material Design 3, intelligent media library management, and high audio engine performance.
problem: Offline music players often feel outdated or lack modern Material UI and high-performance playback management.
solution: Built using Flutter & Dart with Material Design 3 guidelines, custom audio playback engine, and intelligent media indexing.
